diagnosis.overall_diagnosis: The location hint points to gaps/incorrect guidance in maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md about (1) selecting the correct build toolchain and standardizing how to reproduce failures and which Maven commands/paths are contractually required, and (2) handling dependency resolution and permissible modification scope for nested/invoker-style test projects. This skill file likely lacks explicit, correct conventions for the benchmark’s required artifacts/paths and for multi-module or nested-test Maven builds, which can cause evaluators/agents to run the wrong commands, patch the wrong module, or miss dependency changes needed for nested test projects.

diagnosed_skills.diagnosis: The skill’s build-repair contract and minimal diagnostic sequence are incomplete and potentially misleading for this benchmark. It does not clearly specify the required repository path pattern (/home/travis/build/failed/<repo>/<id>), the required diagnostic artifact location (/home/travis/build/failed/failed_reasons.txt), and the patch artifact naming/location pattern (/home/travis/build/failed/<repo>/<id>/patch_{i}.diff). It also doesn’t give concrete, standard Maven reproduction commands for legacy/multi-module builds, nor guidance on choosing the correct toolchain (Maven wrapper vs system Maven, Java version selection) for consistent CI reproduction. Additionally, it lacks clear guidance for nested test projects (e.g., Maven Invoker integration test projects under src/it) where dependencies and POMs may live inside nested directories and may require edits within those nested test project poms/settings, while also clarifying modification boundaries (what’s acceptable to change vs what should remain fixtures).
diagnosed_skills.repair_instruction: Edit maven-build-lifecycle/SKILL.md to: (1) Correct and generalize the artifact/contract section to match this benchmark: require writing analysis to /home/travis/build/failed/failed_reasons.txt; require creating at least one non-empty unified diff at /home/travis/build/failed/<repo>/<id>/patch_{i}.diff (not a hardcoded google/auto path); and require applying the patch to the repo and verifying real file changes. (2) Expand the minimal diagnostic sequence with explicit, reproducible Maven commands for multi-module builds (e.g., mvn -e -X test, mvn -q -DskipTests, mvn -pl/-am usage) and include guidance on using ./mvnw when present vs system mvn, plus checking/setting JAVA_HOME/maven-toolchains/target Java level. (3) Add a dedicated subsection for nested/invoker integration test projects: how to locate nested POMs under src/it, how dependency resolution differs (local repo, parent POM references, relativePath), and what files are in-scope to modify to fix dependency issues in those nested projects (nested pom.xml, invoker settings) while preserving unrelated fixtures; also clarify when to change root pom.xml vs nested test project pom.xml.
